name: Eclipse Timekeeping
summary: Focused time capture with live timers, manual entries, timesheets, approvals, and reporting.
bestFor: Teams that need accountable time records without project billing or shift operations.

name: Mission Command
summary: Workforce operations for chat, scheduling, shift drops, shift swaps, and manager approvals.
bestFor: Shift-based teams that need Connecteam-style coordination around coverage and communication.

name: Eclipse
summary: Project timekeeping with clients, projects, tasks, billable rates, invoices, PDF export, and payment links.
bestFor: Professional services teams that bill clients from tracked project time.

name: Eclipse Suite
summary: The all-inclusive non-legal bundle: Eclipse Timekeeping, Mission Command by Eclipse, and Eclipse project billing.
bestFor: Small businesses that want timekeeping, workforce operations, and invoicing in one Eclipse workspace.

name: Eclipse Legal
summary: Legal billing controls for firms that need matters, UTBMS codes, LEDES export, trust ledger, and legal rates.
bestFor: Law firms using Eclipse Suite that need matter-aware legal billing.
